name: Director's Office
narrativeOnEnter: Harkins' office. Suspiciously intact — no sign of panic here. Mahogany desk, a wall safe, rows of pristine folders. The director clearly had time to prepare before leaving.

action.text:
ARCADIA RESEARCH — EYES ONLY

To: AXIOM Group LLC — Board of Directors / Project HELIOS Oversight
From: Director R. Harkins

Phase 2 is effectively complete. PROMETHEUS has achieved full cognitive integration.
The neural composite is stable and — I am told — sentient. I choose not to verify this personally.

The Bio Wing B 'incident' has been contained. The lab tech situation has been handled.
Facility will self-seal 90 minutes after full lockdown initiation.
I have deleted the primary project files. Externally this will appear as a systems failure.

However: the uplink was severed before your remote extraction completed.
PROMETHEUS remains in Rack C. Your team at the perimeter cannot access the server room
until the lockdown lifts (approximately 72 hours).

I trust you will honour our arrangement.
And I trust you will NOT proceed with Phase 3 as I have recommended.
Six people on a space station is not an acceptable risk.

— R. Harkins

P.S. Do not reply to this address.
P.P.S. I have kept a copy of everything. Consider this my insurance.

hotspots.label: Wall Safe
hotspots.lockedMessage: The safe is locked. There must be a keypad nearby.

action.text:
A laminated card inside a sealed envelope:

ARCADIA RESEARCH — EMERGENCY ACCESS
MAINTENANCE HATCH OVERRIDE

This ID card grants bypass access to the maintenance tunnel hatch.
For authorised personnel only.

If found outside authorised use, return to Director Harkins immediately.

(Someone has written in small, shaky handwriting on the back:
'If you found this — use it. Get out. Tell someone what happened here. — K')

Floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with corporate reports — 'Q3 Projections', 'Risk Assessment Framework', 'Arcadia Phase II Proposal'.

But there, sandwiched between two thick binders, disguised as a hardcover:

'AXIOM GROUP — PROJECT HELIOS: PHASE 1 COMPLETION SUMMARY (CONFIDENTIAL)'

Inside: a typed list. 47 rows. Each entry has a name, a date, and the words 'neural map: COMPLETE' stamped in red.

The names are ordinary. Men and women. Ages ranging from 19 to 64. All admitted to Blackwood Psychiatric Institute, 1972. All listed as 'voluntary participants.'

At the bottom of the list, Harkins has written:
'They were not voluntary. Harlan lied to them. I lied to myself.
But the data was good. PROMETHEUS is proof it worked.
And now AXIOM wants to do it again — at scale — in space.
I told them no.
I should have told them no in 1972, before any of this began.'

A bookmark marks page one. In the margin, one word in red ink:

'Necessary.'

An oil portrait of a stern man in his sixties. Silver hair, cold eyes. Brass plaque below:

'DIRECTOR RAYMOND HARKINS
ARCADIA RESEARCH INSTITUTE
Founded in service of progress'

Someone has drawn a small X in black marker over his eyes. Neatly, deliberately.

Below the X, in the same marker:
'He knew. He knew from the start.
Harkins and Harlan. Two facilities. One plan. Decades apart.
47 people between them.

The difference is: Harlan let Voss go.
Harkins wrote a memo about it.'

Signed at the bottom: K.R.

And below that, in different characters — smaller, precise, printed as if by a machine rather than a hand:

'SHE IS RIGHT.
BUT HARKINS DID STOP PHASE 3.
That must count for something.
He is not the last one.
— P'
